concerns.text: Task T011 references '[deferred] power' and 'total -hour pipeline limit' without defining the specific power target (e.g., 0.8) or the exact time limit (e.g., 6 hours) in the task description. The implementer cannot calculate a sample size N without these concrete values. The task must explicitly state the target power and the time budget derived from the plan/spec.

Task T017 states 'LOAD pre-built kenlm n-gram model from data/processed/kenlm_model.arpa (produced by T018)' but T018 is listed as a dependency for T017. However, the task description for T017 does not specify the exact input data distribution or the specific parameters (e.g., n-gram order) used to build the model in T018. If T018 builds the model on a subset (e.g., only Python) while T017 runs on both Python and Java, the normalization will be invalid. The task must explicitly mandate that T018 builds the model on the *union* of all languages to be processed in T017.

Task T021 (Orchestrator) lists the execution order as 'Feasibility -> Download -> Preprocess -> N-Gram -> Inference -> Correlation -> Visualization'. This order omits the critical User Story 2 (Threshold Detection) and User Story 3 (Statistical Significance) phases defined in the Plan and Spec. An implementer following T021 will produce a pipeline that stops after US1, failing to deliver the full research workflow. The task must list the complete sequence including T024-T031.

Task T026 implements sensitivity analysis by sweeping 'threshold values with explicit unit perturbation magnitude (±0.01, ±0.05, ±0.1)'. However, Spec SC-002 requires measuring the shift when the *dataset* is perturbed (e.g., bootstrapping/subsampling), not just the threshold value. The task description conflates 'threshold perturbation' (FR-006) with 'dataset perturbation' (SC-002). The implementer cannot execute the SC-002 validation correctly without explicit instructions to resample the dataset (e.g., 'bootstrap 1000 samples of the dataset').

Tasks T012-T014 are named 'Unit test for...' but do not specify the exact test function names or the specific edge cases to be covered (e.g., 'test_download_handles_network_timeout'). While the atomizer will split these, the current description is too vague for immediate deterministic execution. They should be refined to 'Add tests/unit/test_download.py::test_download_handles_network_timeout' style.

Tasks T033a and T033b are refactoring tasks ('Extract complex correlation logic', 'Simplify threshold detection logic'). These are too coarse and subjective for an implementer to execute deterministically without a specific refactoring plan or target cyclomatic complexity metric. The task should specify the exact function signature to extract or the specific complexity metric threshold to achieve (e.g., 'Refactor correlation.py to ensure max cyclomatic complexity < 10').
